# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# PHASE 2: Defines the business logic from staging tables to analytical models. #
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
modeling_spec:
  purpose: "Transform staging data into business-ready models for financial analysis, accounting compliance, and business intelligence reporting."

  design_principles:
    intermediate_purpose: "Create reusable, business-centric data models that implement double-entry accounting principles, financial calculations, and cross-functional business logic."
    marts_purpose: "Build analysis-ready fact and dimension tables optimized for financial reporting, business analytics, and regulatory compliance."
    grain_importance: "Each model must have a clearly defined grain that represents the primary business entity, transaction, or time period being analyzed."

  intermediate_models:
    - name: int_quickbooks__account_classifications
      description: Account classifications, multipliers, adjusted balances, and parent account presentation derived from QuickBooks accounts
      grain: One row per source account record keyed by (account_id, source_relation); duplicates from source may exist
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__account
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_quickbooks__account with all columns passed through unchanged. - Derive classification: - If source classification is not NULL, keep it. - Else map by exact case-sensitive account_type: - Asset: account_type IN (''Bank'',''Other Current Asset'',''Fixed Asset'',''Other Asset'',''Accounts Receivable'') - Equity: account_type = ''Equity'' - Expense: account_type IN (''Expense'',''Other Expense'',''Cost of Goods Sold'') - Liability: account_type IN (''Accounts Payable'',''Credit Card'',''Long Term Liability'',''Other Current Liability'') - Revenue: account_type IN (''Income'',''Other Income'') - If none match and source classification is NULL, classification remains NULL. - Derive multiplier: -1 when classification IN (''Liability'',''Equity''); 1 when classification = ''Asset''; else NULL. - Derive financial_statement_helper: ''balance_sheet'' when classification IN (''Asset'',''Liability'',''Equity''); else ''income_statement''. - Derive transaction_type: ''debit'' when classification IN (''Asset'',''Expense''); else ''credit''. - Compute adjusted_balance by multiplying balance by multiplier; if either input is NULL, adjusted_balance is NULL; numeric scale as DECIMAL(38,6). - Left join the same accounts table as parent_accounts on parent_account_id = parent_accounts.account_id and matching source_relation. - parent_account_number: if is_sub_account = TRUE, use parent_accounts.account_number; else use own account_number; NULL if parent not found. - parent_account_name: if is_sub_account = TRUE, use parent_accounts.fully_qualified_name; else use own fully_qualified_name; NULL if parent not found. - No aggregation or sorting is performed; source ordering is preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary account identifier; pairs with source_relation to define row grain
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source relation identifier used with account_id for grain and parent joins
      - name: account_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account number; used when not a sub-account to populate parent_account_number
      - name: is_sub_account
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if this account has a parent_account_id; controls selection of parent_account_number and parent_account_name
      - name: parent_account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the parent account; joined on account_id and source_relation and referenced when is_sub_account is TRUE
      - name: name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account display name from source
      - name: account_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: QuickBooks account type; used for classification derivation via exact case-sensitive matching
      - name: account_sub_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: QuickBooks account subtype from source
      - name: balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Account balance from source used to compute adjusted_balance
      - name: balance_with_sub_accounts
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Balance including sub-accounts passed through unchanged
      - name: is_active
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if the account is active in the source
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Account creation timestamp from source
      - name: currency_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Currency identifier/code from source
      - name: description
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Optional account description from source
      - name: fully_qualified_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Hierarchical fully qualified account name; used when not a sub-account to populate parent_account_name
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Last update timestamp from source
      - name: classification
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Final classification: source value if present, otherwise derived from account_type to Asset/Equity/Expense/Liability/Revenue; may be NULL'
      - name: multiplier
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Balance multiplier based on classification: -1 for Liability/Equity, 1 for Asset, else NULL'
      - name: financial_statement_helper
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Statement grouping helper: ''balance_sheet'' for Asset/Liability/Equity, else ''income_statement'''
      - name: transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Normal balance direction: ''debit'' for Asset/Expense, else ''credit'''
      - name: adjusted_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Balance multiplied by multiplier; NULL if balance or multiplier is NULL
      - name: parent_account_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'If is_sub_account TRUE: parent account_number via join; else own account_number; NULL if parent not found'
      - name: parent_account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'If is_sub_account TRUE: parent fully_qualified_name via join; else own fully_qualified_name; NULL if parent not found'
    - name: int_quickbooks__bill_double_entry
      description: 'Double-entry accounting entries for QuickBooks bills: debit expense and credit accounts payable, one or more rows per bill line'
      grain: One row per (transaction_id, source_relation, index, transaction_type, account_id)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__bill
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__bill_line
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__item
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__account
      business_logic: '- Source tables: - Bills from staging.stg_quickbooks__bill - Bill lines from staging.stg_quickbooks__bill_line - Items from staging.stg_quickbooks__item - Accounts from staging.stg_quickbooks__account - Identify Accounts Payable accounts by keeping accounts where account_type is Accounts Payable, active, and not a sub-account; retain account_id and source_relation. - Join bills to bill_lines on bill_id and source_relation; left join items on item_id and source_relation. - For each joined bill line: - Determine bill line type: - Account-based if an expense account is present on the line - Item-based if an expense item is present - Otherwise no account mapping - Set account_id to the expense account from the line, falling back to the item’s expense account. - Set class_id from the line’s account-based class, falling back to the item-based class. - Compute converted_amount as amount multiplied by the bill exchange rate, defaulting the rate to 1 when missing. - Exclude lines without any account mapping to ensure the debit account_id exists. - Output two legs per remaining bill line using a union of: - Debit leg: expense account_id; transaction_type = debit. - Credit leg: join to AP accounts by source_relation and emit one row per matching AP account; if none match, emit one row with a NULL account_id; transaction_type = credit. - Set customer_id to NULL on all rows; carry through vendor_id, department_id, created_at, and updated_at from bills; set transaction_source to bill. - No explicit output ordering is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Bill identifier from stg_quickbooks__bill; repeats across debit and credit legs and is not unique
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier used for joining bills, lines, items, and selecting AP accounts; passed through unchanged
      - name: index
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Bill line index from stg_quickbooks__bill_line; preserved for both debit and credit legs
      - name: transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Bill transaction date from stg_quickbooks__bill; passed through as-is
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Always NULL placeholder; no customer is associated with bill entries
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor ID from stg_quickbooks__bill; passed through
      - name: amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Original bill line amount from stg_quickbooks__bill_line; used on both legs without rounding or aggregation
      - name: converted_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: Amount converted by multiplying amount by the bill exchange rate, defaulting the rate to 1 when missing
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Debit leg uses the expense account from the line or the item’s expense account; credit leg uses the AP account matched by source_relation, or NULL if none match
      - name: class_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Class from the account-based class on the line, falling back to the item-based class; passed to both legs
      - name: department_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department from stg_quickbooks__bill; passed through
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Bill creation timestamp from stg_quickbooks__bill; passed through with timezone
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Bill last update timestamp from stg_quickbooks__bill; passed through with timezone
      - name: transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Leg indicator: debit for expense line, credit for accounts payable; never NULL'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: transaction_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant value bill identifying the originating transaction
        tests:
        - not_null
    - name: int_quickbooks__cashflow_analysis
      description: Unified cash flow from invoices, bills, and customer payments with timing categories, signed net amounts, and cumulative/rolling sums ordered by transaction_date
      grain: One row per invoice, bill, or customer payment (union-all cash flow record)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice (invoice_id, customer_id, transaction_date, due_date, total_amount, balance, source_relation)
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__bill (bill_id, vendor_id, transaction_date, due_date, total_amount, balance, source_relation)
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__payment (payment_id, customer_id, transaction_date, total_amount, source_relation)
      business_logic: '- Filter sources: - Invoices: include rows where total_amount is not null. - Bills: include rows where total_amount is not null. - Payments received: include rows where customer_id and total_amount are not null. - Payments made: none included (vendor payments are handled via bills; the CTE returns an empty set). - Build accounts receivable (Invoice): - cash_flow_direction = ''Inflow''; counterparty_type = ''Customer''. - outstanding_amount = COALESCE(balance, 0); realized_amount = total_amount - outstanding_amount. - cash_flow_status: ''Collected'' if outstanding_amount = 0; ''No Due Date'' if due_date is null; otherwise: ''Outstanding - Not Due'' if current_date <= due_date; else past-due buckets based on days past due: 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+. - expected_cash_date: transaction_date if settled (outstanding_amount = 0); else due_date if present; else transaction_date + 30 days. - Build accounts payable (Bill): - cash_flow_direction = ''Outflow''; counterparty_type = ''Vendor''. - outstanding_amount and realized_amount computed as for receivables; cash_flow_status uses ''Paid'' when outstanding_amount = 0; expected_cash_date follows the same rule. - Build actual cash inflows (Payment Received): - cash_flow_direction = ''Inflow''; counterparty_type = ''Customer''. - outstanding_amount = 0; realized_amount = total_amount; due_date = transaction_date; cash_flow_status = ''Collected''; expected_cash_date = transaction_date. - Actual cash outflows (Payment Made): empty (no rows). - Union-all all cash flow records; duplicates are preserved; realized_amount is taken from each source as defined above. - Derive time dimensions from transaction_date: calendar year, quarter (1–4), month (1–12), week-of-year, and the start dates of the containing month, quarter, and week. - cash_flow_timing: - ''Realized'' if cash_flow_status is ''Collected'' or ''Paid''. - Otherwise compare expected_cash_date to current_date: ''Overdue'' (on or before today), ''Due Soon (30 days)'' (within 30 days), ''Due Medium Term (60 days)'' (within 60 days), ''Due Long Term (90 days)'' (within 90 days), else ''Due Future (90+ days)''. - Signed net amounts: - net_cash_flow_amount: positive for Inflow, negative for Outflow, based on total_amount. - net_realized_amount: positive for Inflow, negative for Outflow, based on realized_amount. - net_outstanding_amount: positive for Inflow, negative for Outflow, based on outstanding_amount. - Window metrics (computed over all rows ordered by transaction_date and including the current row): - cumulative_cash_flow: running total of net_realized_amount from the beginning through the row’s transaction_date. - rolling_30d_cash_flow: sum of net_realized_amount over the 30 calendar days ending on the row’s transaction_date (inclusive), including all rows with the same date. - rolling_90d_cash_flow: sum of net_realized_amount over the 90 calendar days ending on the row’s transaction_date (inclusive). - cash_flow_health (first matching rule applies): - ''Payment Overdue'' if cash_flow_timing = ''Overdue'' and net_outstanding_amount < 0. - ''Collection Overdue'' if cash_flow_timing = ''Overdue'' and net_outstanding_amount > 0. - ''Negative 30d Trend'' if rolling_30d_cash_flow < 0. - ''Negative 90d Trend'' if rolling_90d_cash_flow < 0. - ''Positive'' if cumulative_cash_flow > 0. - Else ''Neutral''. - liquidity_risk_level: - ''High Risk'' if net_outstanding_amount < -10000 and cash_flow_timing = ''Overdue''. - ''Medium Risk'' if net_outstanding_amount < -5000 and cash_flow_timing is ''Overdue'' or ''Due Soon (30 days)''. - ''Low Risk'' if net_outstanding_amount < 0 and cash_flow_timing = ''Due Soon (30 days)''. - Else ''No Risk''. - cash_conversion_days: number of days between due_date and transaction_date when both exist; for payments this typically equals 0 because due_date equals transaction_date; null if either date is missing. - Notes: All timing/status logic uses current_date at execution; rolling windows are inclusive of the row’s date and computed across the entire dataset.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source transaction identifier (invoice_id, bill_id, or payment_id); not unique across types; present for all included records
        constraints:
        - not_null
      - name: transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Literal type per source: ''Invoice'', ''Bill'', or ''Payment Received'' (no ''Payment Made'' rows included)'
      - name: cash_flow_direction
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Cash flow sign category: ''Inflow'' for invoices/payments received; ''Outflow'' for bills'
      - name: counterparty_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer ID for inflows and Vendor ID for bills; may be null for some invoices
      - name: counterparty_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Counterparty class: ''Customer'' for inflows and ''Vendor'' for bills'
      - name: transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Source transaction date used for all time dimensions and window ordering
      - name: due_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: For invoices/bills, the source due_date (nullable); for payments, set equal to transaction_date
      - name: total_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Monetary amount from source; non-null by filter; used as the unsigned base for netting and realized/outstanding splits
      - name: outstanding_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: 'Unpaid balance: COALESCE(balance, 0) for invoices/bills; 0 for payments'
      - name: realized_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(29,6)
        description: 'Amount realized to cash: total_amount - outstanding_amount for invoices/bills; total_amount for payments'
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Originating source relation identifier carried through unchanged
      - name: cash_flow_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Status based on outstanding_amount and due_date vs current_date: ''Collected''/''Paid'', ''No Due Date'', ''Outstanding - Not Due'', or past-due buckets (1–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+ days)'
      - name: expected_cash_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: 'Estimated realization date: transaction_date if settled, else due_date if present, else transaction_date + 30 days; may be null if dates are missing'
      - name: transaction_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Year number extracted from transaction_date
      - name: transaction_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Quarter number (1–4) extracted from transaction_date
      - name: transaction_month
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Month number (1–12) extracted from transaction_date
      - name: transaction_week
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Week number extracted from transaction_date
      - name: transaction_month_start
        data_type: DATE
        description: Start date of the month containing transaction_date
      - name: transaction_quarter_start
        data_type: DATE
        description: Start date of the quarter containing transaction_date
      - name: transaction_week_start
        data_type: DATE
        description: Start date of the week containing transaction_date
      - name: cash_flow_timing
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Timing category per expected_cash_date vs current_date: ''Realized'', ''Overdue'', ''Due Soon (30 days)'', ''Due Medium Term (60 days)'', ''Due Long Term (90 days)'', or ''Due Future (90+ days)'''
      - name: net_cash_flow_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: 'Signed total_amount: positive for Inflow, negative for Outflow'
      - name: net_realized_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(29,6)
        description: 'Signed realized_amount: positive for Inflow, negative for Outflow; basis for window calculations'
      - name: net_outstanding_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: 'Signed outstanding_amount: positive for receivables, negative for payables'
      - name: cumulative_cash_flow
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Running total of net_realized_amount over all rows ordered by transaction_date, including the current row
      - name: rolling_30d_cash_flow
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of net_realized_amount over the 30 calendar days ending on transaction_date, inclusive
      - name: rolling_90d_cash_flow
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of net_realized_amount over the 90 calendar days ending on transaction_date, inclusive
      - name: cash_flow_health
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Health label by precedence: overdue payments/collections, negative 30d/90d trends, positive cumulative, else neutral'
      - name: liquidity_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk tier from net_outstanding_amount thresholds with timing: High (<-10000 & Overdue), Medium (<-5000 & Overdue/Due Soon), Low (<0 & Due Soon), else No Risk'
      - name: cash_conversion_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days between due_date and transaction_date when both exist; typically 0 for payments since due_date equals transaction_date; null otherwise
    - name: int_quickbooks__customer_lifecycle
      description: Customer lifecycle metrics derived from QuickBooks invoices (balance not null), payments, and invoice lines; one row per (customer_id, source_relation) with activity segments and KPIs
      grain: One row per (customer_id, source_relation) with at least one invoice where balance is not NULL
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__customer
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice_line
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__payment
      business_logic: 'Overview - Build metrics from: - Customers: staging.stg_quickbooks__customer - Invoices: staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice filtered to balance is not null and customer_id is not null - Invoice lines: staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice_line joined to the filtered invoices - Payments: staging.stg_quickbooks__payment filtered to customer_id is not null - Keep only customers that have at least one qualifying invoice. - Metrics using current_date are evaluated at run time. Invoice summary (grouped by customer_id, source_relation) - total_invoices: distinct invoice count - total_invoice_amount: sum of invoice total_amount, treating nulls as zero - outstanding_balance: sum of invoice balance, treating nulls as zero - first_invoice_date: earliest invoice transaction_date - last_invoice_date: latest invoice transaction_date - active_months: distinct count of months with invoices based on transaction_date - avg_invoice_amount: average of invoice total_amount, treating nulls as zero Payment summary (grouped by customer_id, source_relation) - total_payments: distinct payment count - total_payment_amount: sum of payment total_amount, treating nulls as zero - first_payment_date: earliest payment transaction_date - last_payment_date: latest payment transaction_date - avg_payment_amount: average of payment total_amount, treating nulls as zero; later defaulted to 0 if no payments exist Product diversity (grouped by customer_id, source_relation) - Join filtered invoices to invoice_lines on invoice_id - Only count lines where the item_id is present - unique_products_purchased: distinct count of item_ids - total_quantity_purchased: sum of sales item quantity, treating nulls as zero Activity and segments (left-join payment and product diversity to invoice summary) - Missing payment and product metrics default to 0 (dates may remain null) - days_since_last_invoice: difference in days between current date and last_invoice_date - days_since_last_payment: difference in days between current date and last_payment_date; null if no payments - customer_value_segment by total_invoice_amount: - > 50,000 → High Value - > 10,000 → Medium Value - else → Low Value - payment_behavior by comparing total_payment_amount to total_invoice_amount: - ≥ 95% → Excellent - ≥ 80% → Good - ≥ 50% → Fair - else → Poor - activity_status by days_since_last_invoice: - ≤ 30 → Highly Active - ≤ 90 → Active - ≤ 180 → Moderately Active - ≤ 365 → Inactive - else → Lost Final selection and derived metrics - Join customers to the activity results on (customer_id, source_relation) and keep only matches. - Bring through customer attributes (name, company_name, display_name, is_active, created_at, balance). - payment_rate_percentage: - If total_payments = 0 → 0 - Else → (total_payment_amount / total_invoice_amount) × 100 rounded to 2 decimals; result may be null or non-finite if total_invoice_amount = 0 - customer_lifespan_days: - If both first and last invoice dates exist → inclusive days between them (last − first + 1) - Else → 0 - monthly_revenue_avg: - If active_months > 0 and total_invoice_amount > 0 → total_invoice_amount / active_months rounded to 2 decimals - Else → 0'
      columns:
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier from stg_quickbooks__customer; join key to all metrics
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier used in joins; pairs with customer_id to define grain
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer name from stg_quickbooks__customer.name (pass-through; may be NULL)
      - name: company_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Company name from stg_quickbooks__customer.company_name (pass-through; may be NULL)
      - name: display_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name from stg_quickbooks__customer.display_name (pass-through; may be NULL)
      - name: customer_is_active
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Customer active flag from stg_quickbooks__customer.is_active (no coercion)
      - name: customer_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Customer creation timestamp from stg_quickbooks__customer.created_at
      - name: customer_current_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Current balance from stg_quickbooks__customer.balance (no transformation)
      - name: total_invoices
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of invoices with balance not null for the customer
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_invoice_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total invoiced amount across qualifying invoices, treating null amounts as zero
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: outstanding_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total outstanding balance across qualifying invoices, treating null balances as zero
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: first_invoice_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest invoice transaction_date among qualifying invoices
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: last_invoice_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest invoice transaction_date among qualifying invoices
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: active_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of months with invoice activity based on transaction_date
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: avg_invoice_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average invoice amount across qualifying invoices, treating null amounts as zero
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_payments
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of payments for the customer; 0 if none
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_payment_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total payment amount for the customer, treating null amounts as zero; 0 if none
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: first_payment_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest payment transaction_date; NULL if no payments
      - name: last_payment_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest payment transaction_date; NULL if no payments
      - name: avg_payment_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average payment amount, treating null amounts as zero; 0 if no payments
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: unique_products_purchased
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of item_ids from invoice lines joined to qualifying invoices; 0 if none
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_quantity_purchased
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total quantity from invoice lines joined to qualifying invoices, treating null quantities as zero; 0 if none
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: days_since_last_invoice
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days between current date and last_invoice_date at execution time
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: days_since_last_payment
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days between current date and last_payment_date at execution time; NULL if no payments
      - name: customer_value_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Value tier by total_invoice_amount: >50k High, >10k Medium, else Low'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: payment_behavior
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Repayment tier by total_payment_amount vs total_invoice_amount: ≥95% Excellent; ≥80% Good; ≥50% Fair; else Poor'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: activity_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Engagement tier by days_since_last_invoice: ≤30 Highly Active; ≤90 Active; ≤180 Moderately Active; ≤365 Inactive; else Lost'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: payment_rate_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If total_payments=0 then 0; else (total_payment_amount/total_invoice_amount)*100 rounded to 2 decimals; may be null or non-finite if denominator is 0
      - name: customer_lifespan_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Inclusive days between first and last invoice dates if present (last − first + 1), else 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: monthly_revenue_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If active_months>0 and total_invoice_amount>0 then total_invoice_amount/active_months rounded to 2 decimals, else 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: New Customer if total_invoices=1; else Champion if days_since_last_invoice≤30 and total_invoices≥5; else Loyal Customer if days_since_last_invoice≤60 and total_invoice_amount≥5000; else Potential Loyalist if ≤90; else At Risk if ≤180; else Cannot Lose Them if ≤365; else Lost Customer
        tests:
        - not_null
    - name: int_quickbooks__invoice_double_entry
      description: Double-entry view of QuickBooks invoice lines producing offsetting AR and revenue/discount entries
      grain: One line-side row plus one AR-side row per invoice line in invoice_filter per source_relation; AR side repeats once per AR account; rows are uniquely identified by (transaction_id, source_relation, index, transaction_type, account_id)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice_line
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__item
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__account
      business_logic: '- Load invoices, invoice_lines, items (including parent to provide parent_income_account_id), and accounts from staging. - Identify Accounts Receivable accounts per source_relation as those marked Accounts Receivable, active, and not sub-accounts. - Join invoices to invoice_lines on invoice_id and source_relation; left join items on sales_item_item_id and source_relation. - For each joined line: - amount equals the invoice line amount. - converted_amount equals amount multiplied by the invoice exchange rate if present; otherwise amount. - invoice_line_transaction_type is: - invoice_lines.detail_type when present; - otherwise SalesItemLineDetail if any of the following are present: invoice_lines.account_id, invoice_lines.sales_item_account_id, items.parent_income_account_id, items.income_account_id; - otherwise DiscountLineDetail if invoice_lines.discount_account_id is present; - otherwise NoAccountMapping. - account_id (line side) is the first non-null among invoice_lines.account_id, invoice_lines.sales_item_account_id, items.income_account_id, invoice_lines.discount_account_id. - class_id is the first non-null among sales_item_class_id, discount_class_id, and the invoice class_id. - Remove lines where invoice_line_transaction_type is SubTotalLineDetail or NoAccountMapping. - Emit rows: - Line side: one row per remaining invoice line with the mapped line account_id; transaction_type is credit unless DiscountLineDetail, then debit; transaction_source is invoice unless DiscountLineDetail, then invoice discount. - AR side: for each AR account in the same source_relation, emit one row with that AR account_id; if no AR accounts exist, emit a single AR row with account_id NULL; transaction_type is debit unless DiscountLineDetail, then credit; transaction_source matches the line side. - Carry transaction_id (invoice_id), source_relation, index, transaction_date, customer_id, vendor_id as NULL, department_id, created_at, and updated_at on all emitted rows.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Invoice identifier
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system key used to scope joins and select AR accounts
      - name: index
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Invoice line position
      - name: transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Invoice transaction date
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer on the invoice
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Always NULL
      - name: amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Unchanged invoice line amount repeated on all emitted rows
      - name: converted_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: Line amount multiplied by the invoice exchange rate when present, else equal to amount
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Posting account; line side uses the mapped line account, AR side uses an active non-sub Accounts Receivable account for the source_relation; may be NULL if the line mapping is missing or no AR account exists; AR side emits one row per AR account
      - name: class_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Class from sales item class, else discount class, else the invoice class
      - name: department_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department from the invoice
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Invoice creation timestamp
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Invoice update timestamp
      - name: transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Line side is credit except discount lines which are debit; AR side is debit except discount lines which are credit
      - name: transaction_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Set to 'invoice' except discount lines which use 'invoice discount'
    - name: int_quickbooks__journal_entry_double_entry
      description: Debit and credit lines for QuickBooks journal entries joined to their headers.
      grain: One row per journal entry line that matches a header (by source_relation and journal_entry_id)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__journal_entry
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__journal_entry_line
      business_logic: '- Load journal entry headers and lines from their staging tables. - Inner join lines to headers on matching journal_entry_id and source_relation; only matched pairs are kept. If duplicates exist in sources, all joined rows are preserved; no de-duplication or aggregation is performed; output ordering is not specified. - Column mapping: - transaction_id comes from the header journal_entry_id; source_relation comes from the header; index comes from the line. - transaction_date, created_at, and updated_at come from the header. - customer_id, vendor_id, amount, account_id, class_id, and department_id come from the line; values are passed through with nulls preserved. - converted_amount is the line amount multiplied by the header exchange rate; if the exchange rate is null, use 1; if amount is null, the result is null; sign is preserved; stored as DECIMAL(38,12) with no extra rounding beyond the data type. - transaction_type is ''debit'' when the line posting_type equals ''Debit'' exactly; otherwise ''credit'' (including null or any other value); output is lowercase and never null. - transaction_source is the constant ''journal entry'' for all rows.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Header journal_entry_id used as the transaction identifier; combines with source_relation and line index to identify a line; nulls preserved.
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source identifier from the header; used in the join to match lines; nulls preserved.
      - name: index
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Line index from the journal entry line; no renumbering; duplicates and nulls preserved.
      - name: transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Journal entry date from the header; pass-through; nulls preserved.
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer on the journal entry line; pass-through; nulls preserved.
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor on the journal entry line; pass-through; nulls preserved.
      - name: amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Original line amount from the line; DECIMAL(28,6); sign and nulls preserved; no extra rounding.
      - name: converted_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: Line amount multiplied by the header exchange rate (defaults to 1 when null); null if amount is null; sign preserved; DECIMAL(38,12).
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account on the journal entry line; pass-through; nulls preserved.
      - name: class_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Class on the journal entry line; pass-through; nulls preserved.
      - name: department_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department on the journal entry line; pass-through; nulls preserved.
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Created timestamp from the header; pass-through with timezone; nulls preserved.
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Updated timestamp from the header; pass-through with timezone; nulls preserved.
      - name: transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Derived from line posting_type: ''debit'' if exactly ''Debit'', otherwise ''credit'' (including null); lowercase; never null.'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: transaction_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant 'journal entry' for all rows; lowercase with space; never null.
        tests:
        - not_null
    - name: int_quickbooks__payment_double_entry
      description: Double-entry accounting view of payment transactions with paired debit and credit entries.
      grain: 'Two rows per payment line (payment_id, source_relation, index): one debit and one credit; duplicates can occur when multiple matching account rows exist for the same source_relation.'
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__payment
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__payment_line
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__account
      business_logic: '- Load payments and payment_lines; join on payment_id and source_relation. - Build account lookups from accounts: - ar_accounts: active, non-sub Accounts Receivable accounts, keyed by source_relation. - undeposited_funds_accounts: active accounts whose name contains "undeposited" (case-insensitive), keyed by source_relation. - For each joined payment/payment_line, produce: - Debit row: account_id is payments.deposit_to_account_id when present; otherwise use the undeposited funds account for the same source_relation. - Credit row: account_id is the Accounts Receivable account for the same source_relation. - Common fields on both rows: - transaction_id from payments.payment_id; source_relation from payments.source_relation; index from payment_lines.index. - transaction_date from payments.transaction_date; customer_id from payments.customer_id; vendor_id is NULL. - amount from payment_lines.amount. - converted_amount equals amount multiplied by payments.exchange_rate, using 1 when exchange_rate is NULL; NULL amount remains NULL. - class_id is NULL; department_id from payments.department_id. - created_at and updated_at from payments. - transaction_type is "debit" for the cash/undeposited funds entry and "credit" for the A/R entry; transaction_source is "payment". - Account lookups join only on source_relation; if multiple matching accounts exist, rows are duplicated accordingly. No explicit sorting is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Payment identifier copied from payments.payment_id.
        constraints:
        - not_null
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier from payments.source_relation.
      - name: index
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Line index from payment_lines.index identifying the payment line within the payment.
        constraints:
        - not_null
      - name: transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Payment transaction date from payments.transaction_date.
        constraints:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer on the payment from payments.customer_id.
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Always NULL for payments.
      - name: amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Line amount from payment_lines.amount; same value on both debit and credit rows; NULLs are preserved.
      - name: converted_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: Amount multiplied by exchange_rate from payments, using 1 when exchange_rate is NULL; NULL amount yields NULL.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Debit: deposit_to_account_id when present, otherwise the active undeposited funds account for the same source_relation; Credit: the active Accounts Receivable account for the same source_relation; may be NULL and can duplicate when multiple matches exist.'
      - name: class_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Always NULL.
      - name: department_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department from payments.department_id.
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Creation timestamp from payments.created_at.
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Last update timestamp from payments.updated_at.
      - name: transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Debit for the cash/undeposited funds entry and credit for the A/R entry.
        constraints:
        - not_null
      - name: transaction_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Literal value 'payment' identifying the originating transaction type.
    - name: int_quickbooks__revenue_analysis
      description: Invoice-level revenue analysis with time dimensions, collection/aging status, customer aggregates, monthly trends, and quality rating
      grain: One row per invoice_id from staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice where total_amount is not null and > 0
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__customer
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice_line
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__item
      business_logic: '- Filter invoices: include only rows with a positive, non-null total_amount. - Build invoice-level base: - outstanding_balance equals the stored balance (may be null); collected_amount equals total_amount minus balance, treating a missing balance as 0. - Derive time fields from transaction_date: calendar year, quarter (1–4), month (1–12), week-of-year, day-of-week (0=Sunday..6=Saturday), first day of month, and first day of quarter; if transaction_date is missing, all derived time fields are null. - collection_status: Fully Collected when balance is missing or zero; Uncollected when balance equals total_amount; Partially Collected when balance is between 0 and total_amount; otherwise Unknown. - aging_bucket based on today and due_date: No Due Date if due_date is missing; Not Due when today is on or before due_date; otherwise bucket by days overdue into 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, or 90+ Days Overdue. - invoice_size_category by total_amount: Large (≥10,000), Medium (≥1,000), Small (≥100), else Micro. - Customer aggregates (by customer_id and source_relation over the filtered invoices) with customer attributes joined: - total_invoices: number of distinct invoices; total_revenue: sum of invoice amounts; avg_invoice_amount: average invoice amount. - first_transaction_date and last_transaction_date: earliest and latest transaction_date. - revenue_last_6_months: sum of invoice amounts dated in the last 6 months (relative to today); revenue_prev_6_months: sum of invoice amounts dated from 12 to 6 months ago; invoices outside each window add 0 to that window. - collection_rate: share of revenue that is fully collected (fully collected revenue divided by total revenue), without rounding. - customer_tier by total_revenue: Enterprise (≥50,000), Corporate (≥10,000), SMB (≥2,000), else Individual. - Monthly aggregates (by revenue_month_start across the filtered invoices): - monthly_total_revenue: total revenue that month; monthly_avg_invoice_amount: average invoice amount that month; monthly_active_customers: number of distinct non-null customers that month. - Growth metrics computed by ascending month start: - month_over_month_growth_pct: percent change vs the previous month’s total revenue, rounded to 2 decimals; shown only when the previous month’s revenue is greater than 0, else null. - year_over_year_growth_pct: percent change vs the same month 12 months earlier, rounded to 2 decimals; shown only when the comparison month’s revenue is greater than 0, else null. - Final output: - Left join invoice rows to customer aggregates on (customer_id, source_relation) and to monthly aggregates on revenue_month_start. If customer_id is null or no customer record matches, customer fields are null. If transaction_date is null, monthly fields are null. - customer_revenue_growth_pct: percent change between last_6 and previous_6 months, rounded to 2 decimals; shown only when previous_6 months revenue is greater than 0, else null. - revenue_quality_rating: Excellent when fully collected and not due; Good when fully collected; Fair when partially collected and not overdue; Poor when overdue; otherwise Unknown. - Note: A product-level analysis is computed but not used in the final result.'
      columns:
      - name: invoice_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique invoice identifier; one output row per filtered invoice_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier carried from the invoice and used to join customer attributes
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier from the invoice; may be null and determines the join to customer aggregates
      - name: transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Invoice transaction date that drives all time-derived fields and monthly joins; may be null
      - name: due_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Invoice due date used for aging; null yields aging_bucket of No Due Date
      - name: total_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Total invoice amount strictly greater than 0 and used in sums, averages, tiers, and collection metrics
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: outstanding_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Invoice balance as stored; may be null and used to determine collection_status
      - name: collected_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(29,6)
        description: Total amount minus balance, treating a missing balance as 0; equals total_amount when balance is missing
      - name: revenue_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar year of transaction_date; null if transaction_date is null
      - name: revenue_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar quarter number (1–4) of transaction_date; null if transaction_date is null
      - name: revenue_month
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar month number (1–12) of transaction_date; null if transaction_date is null
      - name: revenue_week
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Week-of-year number from transaction_date; null if transaction_date is null
      - name: revenue_dayofweek
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Day-of-week number from transaction_date (0=Sunday..6=Saturday); null if transaction_date is null
      - name: revenue_month_start
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of the calendar month of transaction_date; null if transaction_date is null
      - name: revenue_quarter_start
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of the calendar quarter of transaction_date; null if transaction_date is null
      - name: collection_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Collection state from balance vs total_amount: Fully Collected, Uncollected, Partially Collected, or Unknown'
      - name: aging_bucket
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Aging category relative to today and due_date: No Due Date, Not Due, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, or 90+ Days Overdue'
      - name: invoice_size_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Invoice size bucket by total_amount: Large (≥10,000), Medium (≥1,000), Small (≥100), else Micro'
      - name: customer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer name joined by (customer_id, source_relation) from the customer table; may be null
      - name: company_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer company name joined by (customer_id, source_relation); may be null
      - name: customer_total_invoices
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of distinct invoices for the customer across filtered invoices; null when no customer aggregate match
      - name: customer_total_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total revenue for the customer across filtered invoices; null when no customer aggregate match
      - name: customer_avg_invoice_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average invoice amount for the customer across filtered invoices; null when no customer aggregate match
      - name: customer_first_transaction
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest transaction_date for the customer; null if all dates are null or there is no match
      - name: customer_last_transaction
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest transaction_date for the customer; null if all dates are null or there is no match
      - name: customer_revenue_last_6_months
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total revenue from invoices dated in the last 6 months; 0 if none; null if no customer aggregate match
      - name: customer_revenue_prev_6_months
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total revenue from invoices dated 6–12 months before today; 0 if none; null if no customer aggregate match
      - name: customer_collection_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of customer revenue that is fully collected (0–1); null if no customer aggregate match
      - name: customer_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Customer value tier by total_revenue: Enterprise (≥50,000), Corporate (≥10,000), SMB (≥2,000), else Individual; null if no match'
      - name: customer_revenue_growth_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change between last_6 and previous_6 months, rounded to 2 decimals; null when previous_6 is not positive or missing
      - name: monthly_total_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total revenue from all invoices in the same calendar month; null if transaction_date is null
      - name: monthly_avg_invoice_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average invoice amount for all invoices in the same calendar month; null if transaction_date is null
      - name: monthly_active_customers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of distinct non-null customers with invoices in the same calendar month; null if transaction_date is null
      - name: month_over_month_growth_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent growth vs the previous month’s revenue, rounded to 2 decimals; null when the previous month’s revenue is not positive or missing
      - name: year_over_year_growth_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent growth vs the same month in the prior year, rounded to 2 decimals; null when the comparison month’s revenue is not positive or missing
      - name: revenue_quality_rating
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Rating: Excellent (fully collected and not due), Good (fully collected), Fair (partially collected and not overdue), Poor (overdue), else Unknown'
    - name: int_quickbooks__vendor_spend_analysis
      description: Vendor spending analytics per bill enriched with vendor performance, monthly trends, purchase category, and payment/aging status
      grain: One row per bill joined to each qualifying bill line (multiple rows per bill when multiple qualifying lines exist; a single row with NULL purchase_category if none)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__bill
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__bill_line
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__vendor
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__item
      business_logic: '- Keep bills where total_amount is not null and greater than 0. - Build bill_spend_base (one row per bill): - bill_date = transaction_date; due_date, total_amount, outstanding_balance = balance; paid_amount = total_amount minus balance treating null balance as 0. - Derive spend_year, spend_quarter, spend_month, and spend_month_start (first day of the bill’s month) from bill_date. - payment_status: - Fully Paid if balance is null or 0 - Unpaid if balance equals total_amount - Partially Paid if balance is between 0 and total_amount - Unknown otherwise - aging_status (relative to current_date): - No Due Date if due_date is null - Not Due if current_date is on or before due_date - 1-30 Days Past Due if due_date passed by up to 30 days - 31-60 Days Past Due if due_date passed by 31-60 days - 61-90 Days Past Due if due_date passed by 61-90 days - 90+ Days Past Due otherwise - purchase_size_category by total_amount: - Large Purchase (>= 10000), Medium Purchase (>= 1000), Small Purchase (>= 100), else Micro Purchase - payment_timeliness (relative to current_date): - If due_date is not null and balance = 0: - Early Payment if current_date is on or before due_date - On Time Payment if paid up to 5 days after due_date - Late Payment if 6-30 days after due_date - Very Late Payment if more than 30 days after due_date - Otherwise Incomplete Payment - Build purchase_category_analysis (one row per bill line with amount > 0): - Join bill lines to items by item_expense_item_id. - Determine purchase_category by lowercasing the item name (if present) otherwise the line description and matching keywords: - Office Supplies: contains office or supplies - Technology: contains software or tech - Professional Services: contains service or consult - Travel & Transportation: contains travel or transport - Marketing & Advertising: contains market or advert - Rent & Facilities: contains rent or lease - Utilities: contains util, electric, or water - Other otherwise - Build vendor_performance_analysis (group by vendor_id and source_relation, then enrich with vendor names): - total_bills = distinct bill count; total_spend = sum of bill amounts; total_paid = sum of paid amounts; total_outstanding = sum of balances - avg_bill_amount = average bill amount - first_transaction_date = earliest bill_date; last_transaction_date = latest bill_date - fully_paid_bills = count of bills with payment_status = Fully Paid - payment_completion_rate = fully paid bills divided by all bills times 100 (not rounded) - on_time_payments = count of bills with payment_timeliness in Early Payment or On Time Payment - on_time_payment_rate = on_time_payments divided by bills with a timeliness value (i.e., excluding Incomplete Payment) times 100; null if none - spend_last_6_months = total spend where bill_date is within the last 6 months relative to current_date - spend_prev_6_months = total spend from 12 to 6 months ago relative to current_date - vendor_tier by total_spend: Strategic Vendor (>= 50000), Major Vendor (>= 10000), Regular Vendor (>= 2000), else Occasional Vendor - payment_risk_level by total_outstanding to total_spend ratio: High (> 0.3), Medium (> 0.1), else Low - Build monthly_spend_trends (group by spend_month_start, spend_year, spend_quarter, spend_month): - monthly_total_spend, monthly_paid_amount, monthly_avg_bill_amount, monthly_bill_count (distinct bills), monthly_active_vendors (distinct vendors) - month_over_month_growth_pct = ((current month total - previous month total) / previous month total) * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; null if the previous month total is not available or is 0 or less - year_over_year_growth_pct = ((current month total - same month prior year total) / prior year total) * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; null if the prior year total is not available or is 0 or less - Final output: - Start from bill_spend_base; left join vendor_performance_analysis on vendor_id and source_relation; left join monthly_spend_trends on spend_month_start; left join purchase_category_analysis on bill_id. - vendor_spend_growth_pct = ((last 6 months spend - previous 6 months spend) / previous 6 months spend) * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; null if previous period is 0 or less. - spend_efficiency_rating: - Excellent if Fully Paid and payment_timeliness is Early Payment or On Time Payment - Good if Fully Paid - Fair if Partially Paid and Not Due - Poor if any Past Due - Unknown otherwise - Joining purchase_category on bill_id returns multiple rows per bill when multiple qualifying lines exist; if no qualifying line, purchase_category is null and only one row is returned.'
      columns:
      - name: bill_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Bill identifier; duplicates appear when multiple qualifying bill lines exist
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system relation carried from the bill and used to join vendor details
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor identifier from the bill used to compute and join vendor performance metrics; may be NULL
      - name: bill_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Bill transaction date used for time dimensions and trends; may be NULL
      - name: due_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Bill due date used for aging and timeliness logic; NULL yields No Due Date and Incomplete Payment
      - name: total_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Total bill amount; only positive, non-null bills are included
      - name: outstanding_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Open balance from the bill; can be NULL; used in payment status and risk calculations
      - name: paid_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(29,6)
        description: Computed as total_amount minus outstanding_balance, treating NULL balance as 0; equals total_amount when balance is NULL or zero
      - name: spend_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar year extracted from bill_date; NULL if bill_date is NULL
      - name: spend_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar quarter number (1-4) extracted from bill_date; NULL if bill_date is NULL
      - name: spend_month
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar month number (1-12) extracted from bill_date; NULL if bill_date is NULL
      - name: spend_month_start
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of the bill’s month; join key for monthly trends
      - name: payment_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Payment state by balance: Fully Paid (balance is NULL or 0), Unpaid (balance = total_amount), Partially Paid (between 0 and total_amount), Unknown otherwise'
      - name: aging_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Aging vs current_date: No Due Date if due_date is NULL; else Not Due or a Past Due bucket (1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ days) based on days past due'
      - name: purchase_size_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Bill size bucket by total_amount: Large (>=10000), Medium (>=1000), Small (>=100), else Micro'
      - name: payment_timeliness
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'For fully paid bills with a due_date: Early Payment (on/before due date), On Time Payment (≤5 days late), Late Payment (6–30 days late), Very Late Payment (>30 days late); otherwise Incomplete Payment'
      - name: vendor_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor name joined by vendor_id and source_relation
      - name: vendor_company_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor company name from the vendor record
      - name: vendor_display_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor display name from the vendor record
      - name: vendor_total_bills
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct bill count per vendor across all filtered bills
      - name: vendor_total_spend
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total billed amount per vendor across all filtered bills
      - name: vendor_avg_bill_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average bill amount per vendor across all filtered bills (not rounded)
      - name: vendor_first_transaction
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest bill_date per vendor across all filtered bills
      - name: vendor_last_transaction
        data_type: DATE
        description: Most recent bill_date per vendor across all filtered bills
      - name: vendor_payment_completion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage of fully paid bills among all bills for the vendor (not rounded)
      - name: vendor_on_time_payment_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage of bills that are Early or On Time among bills with a timeliness value; NULL if none
      - name: vendor_spend_last_6_months
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total billed amount for the vendor over the last 6 months relative to current_date
      - name: vendor_spend_prev_6_months
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total billed amount for the vendor from 12 to 6 months ago relative to current_date
      - name: vendor_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Vendor tier by total spend: >=50000 Strategic Vendor, >=10000 Major Vendor, >=2000 Regular Vendor, else Occasional Vendor'
      - name: payment_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk by outstanding-to-total spend ratio: >0.3 High, >0.1 Medium, else Low'
      - name: vendor_spend_growth_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage change between last 6 months and previous 6 months, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if the previous period is 0 or less
      - name: monthly_total_spend
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total billed amount across all bills in the same spend_month_start
      - name: monthly_avg_bill_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average bill amount across all bills in the same spend_month_start (not rounded)
      - name: monthly_active_vendors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct vendor count across all bills in the same spend_month_start
      - name: month_over_month_growth_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage change from the previous month’s total, ordered by spend_month_start, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if the previous month total is absent or ≤ 0
      - name: year_over_year_growth_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage change from the same month in the prior year, ordered by spend_month_start, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if the prior value is absent or ≤ 0
      - name: purchase_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Category inferred from item name or line description keywords; multiple categories per bill yield multiple rows; NULL if no qualifying line
      - name: spend_efficiency_rating
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Bill-level rating: Excellent for fully paid and early/on-time, Good for fully paid, Fair for partially paid and not due, Poor for any past due, else Unknown'
