      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__cashflow_analysis
      business_logic: 'Data preparation: - Start from intermediate.int_quickbooks__cashflow_analysis (historical and outstanding cash flow records). - Historical_monthly_summary over transaction_type in Payment Received or Payment Made: - Group by transaction_month_start, transaction_year, transaction_quarter, transaction_month. - Compute monthly_cash_inflows (sum of net_realized_amount where Payment Received), monthly_cash_outflows (sum of absolute net_realized_amount where Payment Made), and monthly_net_cash_flow (sum of net_realized_amount for both types). - Compute outstanding_receivables/payables (sum of outstanding_amount where cash_flow_status starts with Outstanding and direction is Inflow/Outflow). - Compute overdue_receivables/payables (sum of absolute net_outstanding_amount where cash_flow_timing is Overdue and direction is Inflow/Outflow). - Compute inflow/outflow transaction counts and active_counterparties (distinct counterparty_id). - Future_cash_flows (forecast horizon): - Filter rows with outstanding_amount > 0 and expected_cash_date from current_date through 12 months ahead (inclusive). - Group by month: forecast_month is the first day of expected_cash_date’s month; also capture year, quarter, and month number. - Aggregations: - forecasted_inflows: sum of outstanding_amount where direction is Inflow. - forecasted_outflows: sum of outstanding_amount where direction is Outflow. - forecasted_net_cash_flow: inflows minus outflows (outflows subtracted). - high_confidence_inflows: inflow sum where cash_flow_status is “Outstanding - Not Due”. - uncertain_inflows: inflow sum where cash_flow_status contains “Past Due”. - risk_adjusted_inflows: inflow sum weighted by cash_flow_status: Not Due=0.95; 1–30 Days Past Due=0.85; 31–60 Days Past Due=0.70; 61–90 Days Past Due=0.50; all other statuses=0.30. - forecast_counterparties: distinct counterparty_id count within the month. Historical trends (last 24 months): - Filter to transaction_month_start within the past 24 months. - Compute moving averages of monthly_net_cash_flow: - ma_3_months: average over the current month and the prior two months. - ma_6_months: average over the current month and the prior five months. - Compute seasonal_avg as a running average by month-of-year, ordered by transaction_year. - Compute volatility_6_months as the rolling standard deviation over the current month and the prior five months. - Compute a month_sequence (not used downstream). Forecast model: - Join future_cash_flows to historical_trends by same month-of-year and the latest historical month before the forecast_month with that month-of-year. - blended_forecast per month: - If forecasted_net_cash_flow is nonzero and ma_3_months exists: 70% of (risk_adjusted_inflows minus forecasted_outflows) plus 30% of ma_3_months. - Else if forecasted_net_cash_flow is nonzero: risk_adjusted_inflows minus forecasted_outflows. - Else if seasonal_avg exists: seasonal_avg. - Else: ma_6_months (may be null). - forecast_confidence: - High if high_confidence_inflows > 2 × uncertain_inflows; Medium if high_confidence_inflows > uncertain_inflows; else Low. Liquidity analysis (ordered by forecast_month ascending): - cumulative_forecast_cash_flow: running total of blended_forecast from the first forecasted month through the current month. - next_3_months_cash_flow: the blended_forecast value for the month two months ahead; null if that month does not exist. - worst_case_3_months: sum of negative blended_forecast values from the current month through the next two months (non-negative values counted as zero). - liquidity_status from cumulative_forecast_cash_flow: below -10000 Critical Cash Gap; below -5000 Moderate Cash Gap; below 0 Minor Cash Gap; otherwise Positive Cash Position. Final scoring and recommendations: - cash_flow_health_score from cumulative_forecast_cash_flow: ≥50000→100; ≥20000→85; ≥5000→70; ≥0→55; ≥-5000→40; ≥-10000→25; else→10. - liquidity_risk_level from worst_case_3_months: < -20000 High Risk; < -10000 Medium Risk; < -2000 Low Risk; else Minimal Risk. - management_recommendation (first-match in order): cumulative_forecast < -10000 → Urgent; < -5000 → Monitor; worst_case_3_months < -10000 → Plan; next_3_months_cash_flow > 50000 → Opportunity; else → Maintain. - forecast_reliability: High confidence with ≥10 counterparties → Very Reliable; High → Reliable; Medium with ≥5 → Moderately Reliable; Medium → Somewhat Reliable; else → Use with Caution. Determinism: - All aggregations are per forecast_month; sums ignore nulls; window calculations order by forecast_month; no additional rounding; status text matches exactly; final output sorted by forecast_month ascending.'
      columns:
      - name: forecast_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of the month for expected cash dates; exactly one output row per month
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: forecast_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar year number of forecast_month (four digits)
      - name: forecast_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar quarter number (1–4) of forecast_month
      - name: forecast_month_num
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar month number (1–12) of forecast_month
      - name: forecasted_inflows
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of outstanding amounts > 0 with direction Inflow for the month; 0 if none
      - name: forecasted_outflows
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of outstanding amounts > 0 with direction Outflow for the month; 0 if none
      - name: forecasted_net_cash_flow
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: 'Net expected cash flow per month: inflows minus outflows; 0 if none'
      - name: risk_adjusted_inflows
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,8)
        description: 'Inflow sum weighted by status: Not Due 0.95; 1–30 0.85; 31–60 0.70; 61–90 0.50; other 0.30; includes only outstanding amounts > 0'
      - name: blended_forecast
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Blended monthly forecast combining risk-adjusted inflows, outflows, and historical averages per the model; may be null
      - name: forecast_confidence
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: High if high-confidence inflows exceed twice uncertain inflows; Medium if they exceed uncertain inflows; else Low
      - name: forecast_counterparties
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct counterparties contributing outstanding amounts in the month
      - name: cumulative_forecast_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Running total of blended_forecast from the first forecasted month through the current month; null if no values exist
      - name: next_3_months_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Blended forecast for the month two months ahead; null if that future month is missing
      - name: worst_case_3_months
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of negative blended_forecast from current month through two months ahead; non-negative values treated as zero
      - name: liquidity_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Derived from cumulative_forecast_cash_flow: below -10000 Critical Cash Gap; below -5000 Moderate Cash Gap; below 0 Minor Cash Gap; else Positive Cash Position'
      - name: cash_flow_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score by cumulative_forecast_cash_flow: ≥50000 100; ≥20000 85; ≥5000 70; ≥0 55; ≥-5000 40; ≥-10000 25; else 10'
      - name: liquidity_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk tier by worst_case_3_months: < -20000 High Risk; < -10000 Medium Risk; < -2000 Low Risk; else Minimal Risk'
      - name: management_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'First-match rule: cumulative < -10000 Urgent; < -5000 Monitor; worst_case < -10000 Plan; next_3_months > 50000 Opportunity; else Maintain'
      - name: forecast_reliability
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Very Reliable if High confidence with ≥10 counterparties; Reliable if High; Moderately Reliable if Medium with ≥5; Somewhat Reliable if Medium; else Use with Caution
    - name: quickbooks__customer_analytics
      description: Customer analytics with revenue trends, behavior patterns, RFM-style scoring, growth percentages, and risk assessments (one row per customer_id, source_relation)
      grain: One row per customer_id and source_relation
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__customer_lifecycle
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__revenue_analysis
      business_logic: '- Start with customer_base as all columns from intermediate.int_quickbooks__customer_lifecycle, one row per (customer_id, source_relation). - Build revenue_details from intermediate.int_quickbooks__revenue_analysis by month per (customer_id, source_relation): • monthly_customer_revenue = sum of total_amount • monthly_customer_invoices = distinct invoice count • monthly_avg_invoice_amount = average total_amount • monthly_collected_amount = sum of collected_amount • monthly_outstanding_balance = sum of outstanding_balance - Compute customer_revenue_trends by aggregating revenue_details per (customer_id, source_relation): • Define windows relative to current_date: - Last 3 months: months starting on or after 3 months ago - Previous 3 months: the 3 months immediately before the last 3 months - Current quarter: months on or after the start of the current quarter - Previous quarter: the 3 months immediately before the current quarter - Current year: months on or after the start of the current year - Previous year: months in the year immediately before the current year • For each window, sum monthly_customer_revenue; sums return 0 when a customer has revenue months outside the window but none inside; customers with no revenue rows have NULLs after the LEFT JOIN. • Activity and stability: - active_months = distinct count of revenue months across all time - active_months_last_12 = distinct count of revenue months within the last 12 months - last_revenue_month = most recent revenue month - revenue_volatility = sample standard deviation of monthly_customer_revenue - avg_monthly_revenue = average of monthly_customer_revenue - revenue_trend_correlation = Pearson correlation between month time and monthly_customer_revenue - Compute customer_behavior_patterns from customer_base: • Pass through base metrics (e.g., total_invoices, avg_invoice_amount, monthly_revenue_avg, customer_lifespan_days, payment_rate_percentage, total_payment_amount, unique_products_purchased, total_quantity_purchased). • acquisition_season by month of first_invoice_date: Winter (Dec/Jan/Feb), Spring (Mar–May), Summer (Jun–Aug), else Fall; defaults to Fall when first_invoice_date is NULL. • annual_transaction_frequency = round(total_invoices*365.0/customer_lifespan_days, 2) when lifespan>0 and invoices>0; else 0. • customer_maturity_stage by customer_lifespan_days: ≥1095 Mature (3+ years); ≥730 Established (2+ years); ≥365 Developing (1+ year); ≥90 Growing (3+ months); else New (< 3 months). - Build customer_segmentation by LEFT JOINing customer_base to customer_revenue_trends and customer_behavior_patterns on (customer_id, source_relation), then compute: • recency_score by days_since_last_invoice: ≤30→5, ≤60→4, ≤90→3, ≤180→2, else 1 (NULL treated as else). • frequency_score by annual_transaction_frequency: ≥12→5, ≥6→4, ≥3→3, ≥1→2, else 1. • monetary_score by total_invoice_amount: ≥50000→5, ≥20000→4, ≥5000→3, ≥1000→2, else 1 (NULL treated as else). • growth_score: if revenue_prev_3_months>0 then by growth ratio (last_3 vs prev_3: >50%→5, >20%→4, >0→3, >-20%→2, else 1); else 3. • payment_score by payment_rate_percentage: ≥95→5, ≥85→4, ≥70→3, ≥50→2, else 1 (NULL treated as else). - Final output: • Growth percentages (3m, QoQ, YoY) are computed only when the respective previous period > 0; value = round(((current - previous)/previous)*100, 2); else NULL. • overall_customer_score = round(average of the five scores, 1). • rfm_segment via ordered rules on R/F/M; default ''Lost''. • recommended_action via ordered rules on R/F/M; default ''Monitor and maintain''. • risk_assessment priority: - High Churn Risk if days_since_last_invoice>180 and total_invoice_amount>10000 - else Medium Churn Risk if days_since_last_invoice>90 and three-month growth%< -50 (growth%=0 when revenue_prev_3_months≤0) - else Payment Risk if payment_rate_percentage<70 - else Volatility Risk if revenue_volatility>avg_monthly_revenue - else Low Risk • Filter out rows where customer_id is NULL and order by total_invoice_amount descending, then overall_customer_score descending.'
      columns:
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier from lifecycle base; part of the grain; not null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Upstream source identifier from lifecycle base; part of the grain; not null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer name from lifecycle base
      - name: company_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Company name from lifecycle base
      - name: display_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name from lifecycle base
      - name: customer_is_active
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Current active flag from lifecycle base
      - name: customer_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Customer creation timestamp from lifecycle base
      - name: total_invoices
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total invoice count from lifecycle base
      - name: total_invoice_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total invoiced amount from lifecycle base
      - name: outstanding_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Outstanding balance from lifecycle base
      - name: first_invoice_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest invoice date from lifecycle base
      - name: last_invoice_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Most recent invoice date from lifecycle base
      - name: avg_invoice_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average invoice amount from lifecycle base
      - name: total_payments
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total number of payments from lifecycle base
      - name: total_payment_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total payment amount from lifecycle base
      - name: payment_rate_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Payment rate percentage from lifecycle base
      - name: unique_products_purchased
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct products purchased from lifecycle base
      - name: total_quantity_purchased
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total quantity purchased from lifecycle base
      - name: customer_lifespan_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days between first and last activity from lifecycle base
      - name: monthly_revenue_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average monthly revenue from lifecycle base
      - name: days_since_last_invoice
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days since the most recent invoice from lifecycle base
      - name: activity_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer activity status from lifecycle base
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle stage from lifecycle base
      - name: customer_value_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer value segment from lifecycle base
      - name: payment_behavior
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Payment behavior label from lifecycle base
      - name: customer_maturity_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Maturity stage by lifespan thresholds (≥1095 Mature; ≥730 Established; ≥365 Developing; ≥90 Growing; else New)
      - name: acquisition_season
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Season by month of first_invoice_date (Winter: Dec/Jan/Feb; Spring: Mar–May; Summer: Jun–Aug; else Fall); defaults to Fall when first_invoice_date is NULL'
      - name: annual_transaction_frequency
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Annualized frequency rounded to 2 decimals when lifespan>0 and invoices>0; else 0
      - name: revenue_last_3_months
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of monthly revenue in the last 3 months; 0 if only older months exist; NULL if no revenue rows
      - name: revenue_prev_3_months
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of monthly revenue in the previous 3 months; 0 if only outside window; NULL if no revenue rows
      - name: revenue_growth_3m_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Growth vs previous 3 months; NULL if previous period≤0; rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: revenue_current_quarter
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of monthly revenue in the current quarter; 0 if only months outside the quarter exist; NULL if no revenue rows
      - name: revenue_prev_quarter
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of monthly revenue in the previous quarter; 0 if only outside window; NULL if no revenue rows
      - name: revenue_growth_qoq_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Growth vs previous quarter; NULL if previous period≤0; rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: revenue_current_year
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of monthly revenue in the current year; 0 if only months outside the year exist; NULL if no revenue rows
      - name: revenue_prev_year
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of monthly revenue in the previous year; 0 if only outside window; NULL if no revenue rows
      - name: revenue_growth_yoy_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Growth vs previous year; NULL if previous period≤0; rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: active_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of revenue months across all time; NULL if no revenue rows
      - name: active_months_last_12
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of revenue months in the last 12 months; 0 if none; NULL if no revenue rows
      - name: revenue_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of monthly revenue; NULL if fewer than 2 months
      - name: avg_monthly_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of monthly revenue; NULL if no months
      - name: revenue_trend_correlation
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Pearson correlation between month time and monthly revenue; range [-1,1]; NULL if fewer than 2 months
      - name: recency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score by days_since_last_invoice (≤30:5, ≤60:4, ≤90:3, ≤180:2, else 1; NULL treated as else)
      - name: frequency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score by annual_transaction_frequency (≥12:5, ≥6:4, ≥3:3, ≥1:2, else 1)
      - name: monetary_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score by total_invoice_amount (≥50000:5, ≥20000:4, ≥5000:3, ≥1000:2, else 1; NULL treated as else)
      - name: growth_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score by 3-month growth ratio when previous period>0 (>50%:5, >20%:4, >0:3, >-20%:2, else 1); else 3
      - name: payment_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score by payment_rate_percentage (≥95:5, ≥85:4, ≥70:3, ≥50:2, else 1; NULL treated as else)
      - name: overall_customer_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of the five scores, rounded to 1 decimal
      - name: rfm_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Segment label from ordered rules on R/F/M; defaults to 'Lost'
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recommended action from ordered rules on R/F/M; defaults to 'Monitor and maintain'
      - name: risk_assessment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk label with priority: High Churn Risk (>180 days since last and total_invoice_amount>10000) → Medium Churn Risk (>90 days and three-month growth%< -50, growth%=0 if prev_3≤0) → Payment Risk (payment_rate<70) → Volatility Risk (volatility>avg_monthly_revenue) → Low Risk'
    - name: quickbooks__financial_dashboard
      description: Executive monthly financial dashboard aggregated from revenue, spend, customer lifecycle, and cashflow summaries
      grain: One row per calendar month (dashboard_month) present in any upstream summary
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__revenue_analysis
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__vendor_spend_analysis
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__customer_lifecycle
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__cashflow_analysis
      business_logic: 'Build monthly summaries: - Revenue summary (from revenue analysis): Group by the revenue month start and its calendar year, quarter, and month number. For each month compute: sum of invoice total amounts, sum of collected amounts, sum of unpaid balances, number of unique invoices, number of unique customers, and the average invoice total amount. - Spend summary (from vendor spend analysis): Group by the spend month start and its calendar year, quarter, and month number. For each month compute: sum of bill total amounts, sum of amounts paid, sum of unpaid balances, number of unique bills, number of unique vendors, and the average bill total amount. - Customer metrics (from customer lifecycle): Group by the month of each customer''s last invoice date. For each month compute: total customers; counts where activity_status is “Highly Active” and where it is either “Highly Active” or “Active”; count of customers in the “High Value” segment; counts where lifecycle_stage is “New Customer” and where it is “Lost Customer”; average and sum of each customer''s total invoice amount. - Cashflow metrics (from cashflow analysis): Group by transaction month start. For each month compute: cash inflow as the sum of positive net cash flow amounts; cash outflow as the sum of the absolute values of negative net cash flow amounts; net cash flow as the overall sum; overdue amount as the sum of absolute outstanding amounts flagged “Overdue”; and the number of transactions marked “High Risk”. Compose the monthly dashboard: - Full outer join the four monthly summaries on their month starts so that any month present in any source is kept. - dashboard_month is the first non-null month start across sources; calendar year/quarter/month number come from revenue or spend (and are null if the month exists only in customer or cashflow sources). - For all monthly metrics pulled from the summaries, emit 0 when a source has no data for that month. Derive trends and operational ratios (time-ordered by dashboard_month ascending): - revenue_growth_rate and spend_growth_rate: percent change versus the previous month; compute only when the previous month’s value is strictly positive; round to 2 decimals; otherwise null. - gross_profit: total_revenue minus total_spend. gross_margin_percentage: (gross_profit ÷ total_revenue) × 100; compute only when total_revenue > 0; round to 2 decimals; otherwise null. - cash_flow_status: “Positive” when net_cash_flow > 0, “Neutral” when = 0, otherwise “Negative”. - receivables_days_outstanding: 30 × (outstanding_receivables ÷ collected_revenue); compute only when collected_revenue > 0; round to 1 decimal; otherwise null. payables_days_outstanding: 30 × (outstanding_payables ÷ paid_amount); compute only when paid_amount > 0; round to 1 decimal; otherwise null. Final KPIs: - revenue_per_customer: total_revenue ÷ active_customers_count; round to 2 decimals; return 0 when the denominator is 0. collection_per_invoice: collected_revenue ÷ invoice_count; round to 2 decimals; return 0 when the denominator is 0. collection_rate_percentage: collected_revenue ÷ (collected_revenue + outstanding_receivables) × 100; round to 2 decimals; return 100 when either input is not greater than 0. collection_risk_level: “High” if overdue_amount exceeds 20% of total_revenue; “Medium” if it exceeds 10%; otherwise “Low”. business_health_score: sum of four components, rounded to 0 decimals: - Margin component: 25 if gross margin percentage > 20, else gross margin percentage × 1.25. - Growth component: 25 if revenue growth rate > 10; 15 if > 0; 10 if > -10; else 0. - Cashflow component: 25 if net cash flow > 0; 15 if at least -10% of total_revenue; else 0. - Receivables component: 25 if receivables days < 30; 15 if < 60; 10 if < 90; else 0. The score is null when gross margin percentage is null. - Exclude rows without a dashboard_month and return results ordered by dashboard_month descending.'
      columns:
      - name: dashboard_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of each month present in any source; never null and unique.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: dashboard_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar year sourced from revenue or spend calendars; null when the month exists only in customer or cashflow sources.
      - name: dashboard_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar quarter (1–4) from revenue or spend; null when the month exists only in customer or cashflow sources.
      - name: dashboard_month_num
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar month number (1–12) from revenue or spend; null when the month exists only in customer or cashflow sources.
      - name: total_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of invoice total amounts for the month; 0 when the month has no revenue.
      - name: collected_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of collected amounts on invoices for the month; 0 when none.
      - name: outstanding_receivables
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of unpaid invoice balances for the month; 0 when none.
      - name: total_spend
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of bill total amounts for the month; 0 when none.
      - name: paid_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of amounts paid on bills for the month; 0 when none.
      - name: outstanding_payables
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of unpaid bill balances for the month; 0 when none.
      - name: gross_profit
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: total_revenue minus total_spend; may be negative; never null.
      - name: gross_margin_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Gross profit divided by revenue × 100, rounded to 2 decimals; null when revenue ≤ 0.
      - name: cash_inflow
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of positive net cash flow amounts for the month; 0 when none.
      - name: cash_outflow
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of absolute values of negative net cash flow amounts for the month; 0 when none.
      - name: net_cash_flow
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Net sum of cash flow amounts for the month; 0 when none; may be negative.
      - name: cash_flow_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Positive when net_cash_flow > 0, Neutral when = 0, otherwise Negative.
      - name: overdue_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of absolute outstanding amounts flagged Overdue for the month; 0 when none.
      - name: receivables_days_outstanding
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 30 × outstanding_receivables ÷ collected_revenue, rounded to 1 decimal; null when collected_revenue ≤ 0.
      - name: payables_days_outstanding
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 30 × outstanding_payables ÷ paid_amount, rounded to 1 decimal; null when paid_amount ≤ 0.
      - name: invoice_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique invoices in revenue for the month; 0 when none.
      - name: bill_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique bills in vendor spend for the month; 0 when none.
      - name: active_customers_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique customers with revenue invoices in the month; 0 when none.
      - name: active_vendors_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique vendors with bills in the month; 0 when none.
      - name: avg_invoice_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average invoice total amount for the month; 0 when no invoices.
      - name: avg_bill_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average bill total amount for the month; 0 when no bills.
      - name: total_customers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of customers in the lifecycle snapshot for the month of their last invoice; 0 when none.
      - name: highly_active_customers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Customers with activity_status “Highly Active” for the month; 0 when none.
      - name: active_customers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Customers with activity_status “Highly Active” or “Active” for the month; 0 when none.
      - name: high_value_customers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Customers in the “High Value” segment for the month; 0 when none.
      - name: new_customers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Customers in the “New Customer” lifecycle stage for the month; 0 when none.
      - name: lost_customers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Customers in the “Lost Customer” lifecycle stage for the month; 0 when none.
      - name: avg_customer_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average total invoice amount per customer in the lifecycle table for the month; 0 when none.
      - name: total_customer_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of total invoice amount across customers in the lifecycle table for the month; 0 when none.
      - name: revenue_growth_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Month-over-month percent change in total_revenue based on ascending month order; rounded to 2 decimals; null when the prior month’s revenue is not positive or missing.
      - name: spend_growth_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Month-over-month percent change in total_spend based on ascending month order; rounded to 2 decimals; null when the prior month’s spend is not positive or missing.
      - name: high_risk_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of cashflow records marked “High Risk” for the month; 0 when none.
      - name: revenue_per_customer
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: total_revenue ÷ active_customers_count, rounded to 2 decimals; returns 0 when active_customers_count is 0.
      - name: collection_per_invoice

      - name: collection_rate_percentage

      - name: collection_risk_level

      - name: business_health_score

        description: Composite score from margin, growth, cashflow, and receivables components; rounded to 0 decimals; null when gross_margin_percentage is null.
    - name: quickbooks__general_ledger
      description: Unified general ledger combining bill, journal entry, and payment double-entry records enriched with account attributes, signed amounts, and running balances
      grain: One row per unique_id (double-entry line item)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__bill_double_entry
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__journal_entry_double_entry
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__payment_double_entry
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__account_classifications
      business_logic: '- Union all rows from intermediate.int_quickbooks__bill_double_entry, intermediate.int_quickbooks__journal_entry_double_entry, and intermediate.int_quickbooks__payment_double_entry; duplicates are preserved. - From the union, select: transaction_id, source_relation, index, transaction_date, customer_id, vendor_id, amount, converted_amount, account_id, class_id, department_id, transaction_type, transaction_source, created_at, updated_at. - Left join intermediate.int_quickbooks__account_classifications on (account_id, source_relation) to enrich account fields; if no match, account_* fields are NULL. - Compute unique_id by building a pipe-delimited string from transaction_id, source_relation, index, account_id, transaction_type, transaction_source in that exact order; treat NULL components as empty strings; hash this string with MD5 to produce a lowercase hex identifier. - Compute adjusted_amount: if account_transaction_type equals transaction_type, use amount; otherwise use amount multiplied by -1; if amount is NULL, adjusted_amount is NULL; when either type is NULL, treat as a mismatch and negate. - Compute adjusted_converted_amount the same way using converted_amount from the union (converted_amount itself is not included in the final output); NULLs propagate. - Compute running_balance as a cumulative sum of adjusted_amount within each (account_id, class_id, source_relation) partition, ordered by source_relation, transaction_date, account_id, class_id with rows unbounded preceding. - Compute running_converted_balance similarly using adjusted_converted_amount with the same partitioning and ordering. - Window ties on all ordering keys are engine-defined; cumulative sums skip NULL values and return NULL only when the entire frame is NULL. - Output one row per double-entry line enriched with account fields, signed amounts, and running balances.'
      columns:
      - name: unique_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lowercase MD5 of the pipe-delimited string built from transaction_id, source_relation, index, account_id, transaction_type, transaction_source in that order; NULL inputs are treated as empty strings.
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source transaction identifier from the unioned double-entry models; preserved as-is.
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Originating model for the entry (bill, journal_entry, payment); used in the account join and in window partitioning and ordering.
      - name: transaction_index
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Line index within the source transaction (from 'index'); preserved as-is.
      - name: transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Transaction posting date from source; used in window ordering.
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier associated with the transaction when applicable; may be NULL.
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor identifier associated with the transaction when applicable; may be NULL.
      - name: amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Raw amount from source used to compute adjusted_amount; may be NULL.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier from source; used to join classifications and to partition running balances.
      - name: class_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Class identifier from source; used to partition running balances; may be NULL.
      - name: department_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department identifier from source; preserved as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: account_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account number from classifications; NULL if no account match.
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from classifications; NULL if no account match.
      - name: is_sub_account
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if the account is a sub-account per classifications; NULL if no account match.
      - name: parent_account_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent account number from classifications; NULL if none or no match.
      - name: parent_account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent account name from classifications; NULL if none or no match.
      - name: account_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: High-level account type from classifications (e.g., Asset, Liability); NULL if no match.
      - name: account_sub_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sub-type within the account_type from classifications; NULL if no match.
      - name: financial_statement_helper
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Helper label from classifications indicating financial statement grouping; NULL if no match.
      - name: account_current_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Current account balance from classifications; NULL if no match.
      - name: account_class
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Classification label from classifications; NULL if no match.
      - name: transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Entry type from source (e.g., Debit/Credit or analogous); determines adjusted_amount sign.
      - name: transaction_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source subtype label from the unioned models; included in unique_id but not used in window partitioning.
      - name: account_transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account-side transaction type from classifications; compared to transaction_type to set amount sign; may be NULL.
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Row creation timestamp from source; preserved as-is.
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Row update timestamp from source; preserved as-is.
      - name: adjusted_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: 'Signed amount: equals amount when account_transaction_type equals transaction_type; otherwise amount multiplied by -1; NULL if amount is NULL.'
      - name: adjusted_converted_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: 'Signed converted amount derived from source converted_amount: equals converted_amount when types match, otherwise negated; NULL if converted_amount is NULL.'
      - name: running_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Cumulative sum of adjusted_amount within each (account_id, class_id, source_relation) partition ordered by source_relation, transaction_date, account_id, class_id; NULLs are skipped.
      - name: running_converted_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: Cumulative sum of adjusted_converted_amount within each (account_id, class_id, source_relation) partition ordered by source_relation, transaction_date, account_id, class_id; NULLs are skipped.
    - name: quickbooks__profitability_analysis
      description: Invoice-level profitability with customer and monthly context (margins, tiers, risk-adjusted profit, and relative performance)
      grain: One row per invoice_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__revenue_analysis
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice_line
      - staging.stg_quickbooks__item
      business_logic: 'Build invoice_details from intermediate.int_quickbooks__revenue_analysis with invoice, customer, dates, amounts, and customer attributes. Build invoice_line_details by joining staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice_line to staging.stg_quickbooks__item on item_id; include only lines with a non-null item_id and a positive, non-null amount; select invoice_id, item attributes, quantity, unit price, and line revenue. For product_cost_analysis per qualifying line: - Treat purchase_cost as a decimal and missing values as 0 to derive item_cost_per_unit. - Compute total_item_cost as quantity (missing treated as 0) times item_cost_per_unit. - Compute line_gross_profit as line_revenue minus total_item_cost. - Compute line_gross_margin_pct as (line_gross_profit / line_revenue) expressed as a percentage rounded to two decimals; if line_revenue is not positive, set to 0. A product_profitability CTE is also derived (product-level KPIs) but not joined to the final output. For invoice_profitability, left join invoice_details to product_cost_analysis by invoice_id and aggregate: - total_cogs: sum of total_item_cost; null if no qualifying lines exist. - gross_profit: sum of line_gross_profit; null if no qualifying lines exist. - invoice_gross_margin_pct: if invoice_total > 0, gross_profit divided by invoice_total as a percentage rounded to two decimals (null if gross_profit is missing); otherwise 0. - unique_products: count of distinct item_id on qualifying lines (0 if none). - total_quantity: sum of quantity (null if no qualifying lines). - avg_product_margin: average of line_gross_margin_pct (null if no qualifying lines). - profitability_tier: based on gross_profit / invoice_total thresholds (>0.4 Highly Profitable; >0.2 Profitable; >0.1 Marginally Profitable; >0 Break Even; otherwise Loss Making, including when the ratio is null or non-positive). For customer_profitability, aggregate invoice_profitability by customer_id: - total_revenue, total_cogs, total_gross_profit as sums. - customer_gross_margin_pct: if total_revenue > 0, total_gross_profit divided by total_revenue as a percentage rounded to two decimals (null if total_gross_profit is missing); otherwise 0. - avg_profit_per_invoice: average of gross_profit (ignores nulls). - margin_volatility: standard deviation of invoice_gross_margin_pct (ignores nulls; null if fewer than two non-null values). - profit_last_6_months: sum of gross_profit for invoices with revenue_month_start in the last 6 months relative to current date; invoices outside the window contribute 0. - profit_prev_6_months: sum of gross_profit for invoices with revenue_month_start in the 6–12 month window before current date; invoices outside the window contribute 0. - customer_profit_tier: thresholded by total_gross_profit (>=20000 High, >=5000 Medium, >=1000 Low, >0 Minimal, else Loss). For monthly_profitability, aggregate invoice_profitability by revenue_month_start, year, and quarter: - monthly_invoices and monthly_customers as distinct counts. - monthly_revenue, monthly_cogs, monthly_gross_profit as sums. - monthly_gross_margin_pct: if monthly_revenue > 0, monthly_gross_profit divided by monthly_revenue as a percentage rounded to two decimals (null if monthly_gross_profit is missing); otherwise 0. - profit_per_customer and profit_per_invoice as sums divided by distinct counts; avg_products_per_invoice as the average unique_products (not used downstream). Final output selects all invoice-level metrics and left joins customer_profitability by customer_id and monthly_profitability by revenue_month_start. Derivations: - customer_profit_growth_pct: if previous 6-month profit > 0, ((last 6 months − previous 6 months) / previous 6 months) as a percentage rounded to two decimals; otherwise null. - relative_performance: compare invoice gross_profit to the customer’s avg_profit_per_invoice (Above Average if >1.5×, Average if >0.8×, else Below; a null comparator yields Below). - risk_adjusted_profit: equals gross_profit when outstanding_balance = 0; if outstanding_balance > 0, scale gross_profit by the collection ratio (collected_amount / invoice_total); otherwise equals gross_profit. - profitability_sustainability: tiers based on invoice_gross_margin_pct and customer_margin_volatility (>30% and <10 Highly Sustainable; >20% and <20 Sustainable; >10% Moderately Sustainable; >0% Low Sustainability; else Unsustainable). Aggregations follow standard null handling (aggregates ignore nulls; sums of only nulls yield null; explicit zeros are used in the 6‑month window sums). The final result set is ordered by transaction_date descending, then gross_profit descending.'
      columns:
      - name: invoice_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Invoice identifier; grouping key with exactly one output row per invoice_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer associated with the invoice as provided by revenue analysis
      - name: transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Invoice transaction date from revenue analysis
      - name: revenue_month_start
        data_type: DATE
        description: Month start date used for monthly aggregation and joins to monthly metrics
      - name: revenue_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar year of revenue_month_start from source revenue analysis
      - name: revenue_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar quarter index of revenue_month_start from source revenue analysis
      - name: invoice_total
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Total invoice amount from revenue analysis (currency precision to 6 decimals)
      - name: collected_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(29,6)
        description: Amount collected toward the invoice (currency precision to 6 decimals)
      - name: outstanding_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Remaining balance on the invoice (currency precision to 6 decimals)
      - name: total_cogs
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: Sum of quantity times item purchase_cost (treated as decimal, missing cost or quantity as 0) across qualifying lines; NULL if no qualifying lines
      - name: gross_profit
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: Sum of line_revenue minus total_item_cost across qualifying lines; NULL if no qualifying lines
      - name: invoice_gross_margin_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'If invoice_total > 0: percentage of gross_profit over invoice_total rounded to two decimals (NULL if gross_profit is NULL); otherwise 0'
      - name: unique_products
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct item_id on qualifying invoice lines (0 if none)
      - name: total_quantity
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of sales_item_quantity across qualifying invoice lines; NULL if no qualifying lines
      - name: avg_product_margin
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of per-line gross margin percent across qualifying lines; NULL if no qualifying lines
      - name: profitability_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Based on gross_profit/invoice_total: >0.4 Highly Profitable; >0.2 Profitable; >0.1 Marginally Profitable; >0 Break Even; otherwise Loss Making (includes null or non-positive ratio)'
      - name: customer_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer tier passed through from revenue analysis for the invoice
      - name: invoice_size_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Invoice size category passed through from revenue analysis
      - name: customer_total_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of invoice_total across all invoices for the customer (NULL if all values are NULL)
      - name: customer_total_profit
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: Sum of invoice-level gross_profit across all customer invoices (NULL if all are NULL)
      - name: customer_gross_margin_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'If total_revenue > 0: percentage of customer_total_profit over total_revenue rounded to two decimals (NULL if customer_total_profit is NULL); otherwise 0'
      - name: customer_avg_profit_per_invoice
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average gross_profit per invoice for the customer (ignores NULL gross_profit; NULL if all NULL)
      - name: customer_margin_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of invoice_gross_margin_pct across the customer's invoices (ignores NULL; NULL if fewer than two non-NULL values)
      - name: customer_profit_last_6_months
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: Sum of gross_profit for invoices with revenue_month_start in the last 6 months relative to current date; invoices outside the window contribute 0
      - name: customer_profit_prev_6_months
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: Sum of gross_profit for invoices with revenue_month_start in the 6–12 months before current date; invoices outside the window contribute 0
      - name: customer_profit_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Bucket by total customer gross profit: >=20000 High Profit Customer; >=5000 Medium; >=1000 Low; >0 Minimal; else Loss Customer'
      - name: customer_profit_growth_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'If previous 6 months profit > 0: percentage change from previous to last 6 months rounded to two decimals; otherwise NULL'
      - name: monthly_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of invoice_total for the month keyed by revenue_month_start (NULL if all values are NULL)
      - name: monthly_gross_profit
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: Sum of gross_profit for the month keyed by revenue_month_start (NULL if all are NULL)
      - name: monthly_gross_margin_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'If monthly_revenue > 0: percentage of monthly_gross_profit over monthly_revenue rounded to two decimals (NULL if monthly_gross_profit is NULL); otherwise 0'
      - name: monthly_avg_profit_per_customer
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Monthly sum of gross_profit divided by monthly distinct customers (NULL if the monthly gross_profit sum is NULL)
      - name: monthly_customers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct customers in the month keyed by revenue_month_start
      - name: relative_performance
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Compare invoice gross_profit to customer avg_profit_per_invoice: >1.5× Above Average Performance; >0.8× Average Performance; else Below Average Performance (NULL comparator yields Below)'
      - name: risk_adjusted_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Equals gross_profit when outstanding_balance = 0; if outstanding_balance > 0, gross_profit is scaled by collected_amount/invoice_total; otherwise equals gross_profit
      - name: profitability_sustainability
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier by invoice_gross_margin_pct and customer_margin_volatility: >30% and <10 Highly Sustainable; >20% and <20 Sustainable; >10% Moderately Sustainable; >0% Low Sustainability; else Unsustainable'
    - name: quickbooks__vendor_performance
      description: Vendor performance summary per vendor_id and source with spend trends, payment behavior, scores, ratings, risks, and strategy.
      grain: One row per vendor_id + source_relation
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__vendor_spend_analysis
      business_logic: '- Build vendor_base from intermediate.int_quickbooks__vendor_spend_analysis (fields used: vendor_id, source_relation, spend_month_start, bill_date, total_amount, bill_id, payment_status, payment_timeliness, outstanding_balance, purchase_category, vendor_name, vendor_company_name, vendor_display_name, vendor_tier, payment_risk_level). - Compute vendor_spend_trends grouped by vendor_id + source_relation: - active_months: distinct count of spend_month_start (NULLs ignored). - first_transaction_date/last_transaction_date: earliest/latest bill_date; days_since_last_transaction: difference in days from today to last_transaction_date (NULL if no bill_date). - total_lifetime_spend: sum of total_amount (NULLs ignored); avg_bill_amount: average total_amount (NULLs ignored); spend_volatility: sample standard deviation of total_amount (NULL if fewer than two non-NULL); total_transactions: distinct count of bill_id (NULLs ignored). - spend_current_quarter: sum of total_amount for months on/after the start of the current quarter; months outside contribute zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if no months qualify. - spend_prev_quarter: sum of total_amount for the prior quarter window (from quarter_start-3 months up to but before quarter_start); outside months contribute zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if no months qualify. - spend_current_year: sum of total_amount for months on/after the start of the current calendar year; outside months contribute zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if no months qualify. - spend_prev_year: sum of total_amount for the previous calendar year window (from year_start-1 year up to but before current year_start); outside months contribute zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if no months qualify. - payment_completion_rate: fully paid bill count divided by total rows, multiplied by 100 (not rounded). - on_time_payment_rate: on-time/early payment count divided by rows excluding ''Incomplete Payment'', multiplied by 100; NULL when that denominator is zero (not rounded). - Compute vendor_category_analysis grouped by vendor_id + source_relation + purchase_category (excluding NULL categories): transaction count, total spend, average spend; rank categories by total spend descending per vendor (ties arbitrary). - Derive vendor_primary_category as the top-ranked category per vendor (ties resolved arbitrarily), exposing its name and spend. - Build vendor_scoring by left-joining vendor_spend_trends and vendor_primary_category to vendor_base on vendor_id + source_relation; aggregate total_outstanding as the sum of outstanding_balance (NULLs ignored; NULL if all NULL) and category_diversity as distinct count of non-NULL purchase_category; carry through vendor_name, vendor_company_name, vendor_display_name, vendor_tier, payment_risk_level (if these vary within a vendor, multiple rows may result). - Compute four scores (each yields 25/20/15/10/5; NULL inputs fall into the lowest bucket of 5): - payment_reliability_score by payment_completion_rate thresholds: ≥95, ≥85, ≥75, ≥65. - timeliness_score by on_time_payment_rate thresholds: ≥95, ≥85, ≥75, ≥65. - relationship_stability_score by days_since_last_transaction thresholds: ≤30, ≤60, ≤90, ≤180. - business_value_score by total_lifetime_spend thresholds: ≥50,000; ≥20,000; ≥5,000; ≥1,000. - Final computations: - overall_performance_score: sum of the four scores. - quarterly_spend_growth_pct: percentage change from prior to current quarter, rounded to two decimals; NULL when prior-quarter spend is not positive. - annual_spend_growth_pct: percentage change from prior to current year, rounded to two decimals; NULL when prior-year spend is not positive. - transaction_value_profile: classify by average transaction size (total_lifetime_spend ÷ total_transactions): >1,000 High Value Transactions; >500 Medium; otherwise Low; when undefined (e.g., zero/NULL transactions) defaults to Low. - performance_rating: by overall_performance_score thresholds: ≥85 Excellent; ≥70 Good; ≥55 Fair; ≥40 Poor; otherwise Critical. - risk_assessment (in priority order): outstanding >30% of lifetime spend High Financial Risk; inactivity >180 days with strategic/major tier High Relationship Risk; on-time rate <70 High Payment Risk; volatility >2× average bill amount High Volatility Risk; outstanding >15% Medium Financial Risk; inactivity >90 days Medium Relationship Risk; otherwise Low Risk. - recommended_strategy (in priority order): high overall (≥85) with strategic/major tier Strengthen Partnership; overall ≥70 with recent activity (≤60 days) Maintain Relationship; low payment rates (on-time <70 or completion <80) Improve Payment Terms; inactivity >180 days Re-engage or Replace; outstanding >20% Address Outstanding Issues; overall <55 Performance Review Required; otherwise Monitor Performance. - avg_monthly_spend: total_lifetime_spend ÷ active_months, rounded to two decimals (NULL when active_months is zero). - avg_transaction_size: total_lifetime_spend ÷ total_transactions, rounded to two decimals (NULL when total_transactions is zero). - dependency_level: based on primary_category_spend thresholds: ≥50,000 High; ≥20,000 Medium; ≥5,000 Low; otherwise Minimal (NULL treated as Minimal). - Exclude rows with missing vendor_id; sort results by overall_performance_score descending, then total_lifetime_spend descending.'
      columns:
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor identifier from source; rows with missing vendor_id are excluded; part of the grain with source_relation.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source dataset identifier; forms the grain with vendor_id; NULL values group together.
      - name: vendor_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor name from source; passed through as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: vendor_company_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor company name from source; passed through as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: vendor_display_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor display name from source; passed through as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: total_lifetime_spend
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total of total_amount for the vendor and source; NULL amounts are ignored; NULL if none are non-NULL.
      - name: avg_bill_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average total_amount per bill for the vendor and source; NULL amounts are ignored; NULL if none are non-NULL.
      - name: total_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of bill_id for the vendor and source; NULL bill_id values are ignored; 0 if none.
      - name: active_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of spend_month_start for the vendor and source; NULL values are ignored; 0 if none.
      - name: first_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest bill_date for the vendor and source; NULL if no bill_date.
      - name: last_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest bill_date for the vendor and source; NULL if no bill_date.
      - name: days_since_last_transaction
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of days from today to last_transaction_date; NULL if last_transaction_date is NULL.
      - name: spend_current_quarter
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of total_amount for months on/after the current quarter start; outside months add zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if none qualify.
      - name: spend_prev_quarter
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of total_amount for the prior quarter window; outside months add zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if none qualify.
      - name: spend_current_year
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of total_amount for months on/after the current year start; outside months add zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if none qualify.
      - name: spend_prev_year
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of total_amount for the previous calendar year window; outside months add zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if none qualify.
      - name: spend_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sample standard deviation of total_amount across bills; NULL if fewer than two non-NULL amounts.
      - name: payment_completion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Fully paid bills as a percentage of all rows for the vendor and source; not rounded.
      - name: on_time_payment_rate

        description: On-time/early payments as a percentage of rows excluding 'Incomplete Payment'; NULL when that denominator is zero; not rounded.
      - name: total_outstanding

      - name: primary_purchase_category
